## ✨ Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the use case this feature would address.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🏢 ERP Module
Which ERP module would this feature affect?
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] CRM
- [ ] Human Resources
- [ ] Financial Management
- [ ] Inventory Management
- [ ] Reporting
- [ ] System Administration
- [ ] Other: _______

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
- [ ] This feature requires new UI components
- [ ] This feature affects existing user workflows
- [ ] This feature needs responsive design
- [ ] This feature impacts accessibility

## 🗄️ Database Impact
- [ ] This feature requires new database tables
- [ ] This feature modifies existing tables
- [ ] This feature needs data migration
- [ ] No database changes required

## 🤖 Copilot Integration
- [ ] This feature could benefit from Copilot code generation
- [ ] I'd like Copilot assistance with implementation
- [ ] This feature involves complex business logic
- [ ] This feature needs comprehensive testing

## 📊 Success Criteria
How will we know this feature is successful?
- [ ] User can accomplish [specific task]
- [ ] Performance improves by [metric]
- [ ] User feedback is positive
- [ ] Feature is well-documented

## 🔗 References
Add any links, mockups, or references that might help with implementation.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
